course.title: Foundation Engineering
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: A structure is supported on six columns arranged as shown in figure below. All columns are 350mm X 350mm in size. The load on each column is shown in Figure. Design the suitable raft foundation (slab-beam type) of the column. The allowable bearing capacity of soil is $7 5 \mathrm { k N } / \mathsf { m } ^ { 2 } .$ Use M15 grade of concrete and mild steel. Show the reinforcement details.
